resource_semantics: Nominal deadlines include launch/collection/persistence/final output. Output caps are post-collection acceptance checks. Peak working set is measured before report serialization, not an enforced full-lifetime RSS bound. This concrete acceptance contract replaces the unqualified proposal of a hard RSS ceiling; no enforcement claim is made. Fixed two cases only.
arithmetic: Builder Fraction; independent verifier integer pairs; canonical codec reused without tail/aggregate/controls.
acceptance: External supervisor exit0 plus matching provisional receipt, two ordered verified cases, no audit denial or FINALIZATION_FAILURE. Never a physical certificate.
